description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing Recurring Deposit Accounts in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and performing various operations on recurring deposit accounts, along with templates and bulk import/export functionalities.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing Recurring Deposit Accounts, including CRUD operations, templates, bulk import/export, and account-specific commands.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or maintaining a recurring deposit account, including default values and allowed options.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists all recurring deposit applications or accounts, with optional pagination and sorting.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Submits a new recurring deposit application based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific recurring deposit application or account, including optional associations.

methods.name: populateTemplateAndAssociations
methods.description: Populates account data with associated transactions and charges, and retrieves template data if requested.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Modifies an existing recurring deposit application or account.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Performs various commands on a recurring deposit account, such as approve, reject, close, calculate interest, or premature close.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Utility method to compare command parameter values case-insensitively.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a recurring deposit application if in the correct state.

methods.name: accountClosureTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for closing or performing other operations on an account.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of recurring deposit accounts.

methods.name: postRecurringDepositTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading an Excel template for bulk import of recurring deposit accounts.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of recurring deposit transactions.

methods.name: postRecurringDepositTransactionsTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading an Excel template for bulk import of recurring deposit transactions.
